goal: A developer can install the skill-factory package with uv and run skillz new with a paragraph or a small YAML or JSON spec to get a structured spec and a spec-compliant canonical skill under skills/<name>/, with CI running ruff and pytest on Linux and Windows

plan.goal: Installable buildable uv package skill_factory with no runtime deps, pytest+ruff dev deps, skillz console script, uv.lock, scoped pytest/ruff config, MIT LICENSE, Python .gitignore entries and CI running ruff and pytest on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest
Deterministic capture of a paragraph or small YAML/JSON spec file into a validated structured skill spec, with an in-package YAML subset reader/writer, fixtures and tests/test_capture.py

skillz CLI with new subcommand that captures input, writes skills/<name>/.factory/spec.json and generates a spec-compliant skills/<name>/SKILL.md with resource dirs only when requested, tested in tests/test_generate.py
